name: Impetus of Hades
description:
- While sneaking, enemies only detect you while within 10 blocks and facing you.
- You can double sneak while undetected or out of enemy sight to enter **chthonic form** for 4 seconds. Strikes that end **chthonic form** critically strike and deal +6♥️ magic damage.
    - **Chthonic Form**: Stealth by descending into shadows, gaining +50% speed and +1 step height. Stealths end upon using items or dealing direct damage.
